scope: Patreon creator fees on a membership payment for a creator paid out in US dollars: platform fee, payment processing, currency conversion and US payout fees. Non-USD payout currencies, Apple's App Store fee on iOS purchases and taxes on fees are out of scope.
structure: Patreon takes a platform fee on each successfully processed payment, excluding sales tax: 10% on the standard plan for pages published after August 4, 2025, and 5%, 8% or 11% on the legacy Founders, Pro and Pro + Merch plans. Payment processing is charged on the payment including tax: 2.9% + $0.30 for cards, Apple Pay and US PayPal or Venmo, and 3.9% + $0.30 for PayPal or Venmo members outside the US. Legacy plans pay micropayment rates of 5% + $0.10 (6% + $0.10 for non-US PayPal) on tiers of $3 or less; the standard plan does not. Founders pay 1.6% + $0.30 on cards and 2.65% + $0.28 on PayPal or Venmo. A 2.5% currency conversion fee applies when a member pays in another currency. Payouts cost $0.25 by US direct deposit or 1% to PayPal (minimum $0.25, capped at $20).
summary: Patreon's standard plan takes 10% of each payment plus 2.9% + $0.30 processing (3.9% + $0.30 for PayPal or Venmo members outside the US). Legacy plans take 5%, 8% or 11%, with micropayment rates on tiers of $3 or less.

notes: The standard 10% plan applies to pages published after August 4, 2025. Earlier pages keep their legacy plan unless the page is unpublished and republished.

Patreon's overview says the standard plan 'applies the same processing rates to all payments, regardless of amount', while its August 2025 article labels that column '> $3'. The calculator follows the overview, so standard-plan payments of $3 or less pay 2.9% + $0.30.
The platform fee is charged on the payment excluding tax. Processing and currency conversion are charged on the payment including tax.
Founders who changed their payout currency keep the 5% platform fee but pay standard processing rates instead of the Founders rates. The calculator's Founders option uses the Founders rates.
The payout fee is charged per payout, not per payment. The calculator applies it as if this payment were paid out on its own.

Patreon's Founders section says tiers of $3 or less are subject to micropayment rates, but its Founders table lists only 1.6% + $0.30 and 2.65% + $0.28. For Founders tiers of $3 or less the calculator uses those listed rates, so your actual rate may differ.
Patreon publishes no rounding rule; the calculator rounds each fee half-up to the cent.
